STAMP REFRESHED AFTER THE 2026-09-04 REBASE, NUMBER UNCHANGED. 19.0-marin was replayed onto origin, so every SHA changed and the stamps written hours earlier were orphaned again -- the same mechanism, and the flag working. Re-measured at b67fa612706 in a clean detached worktree, and it reads what the floor already said. The invocation is confirmed rather than assumed: lint_sql_injection is not orphaned, its floor is 9, and the same run reads 9. Scope trap worth recording, because I hit it: run from the REPO ROOT, where 'odoo/' means the core package and the lint roots are 'odoo addons'; run one level up and ruff reports 3,117 findings from the bundled addons against a hard-zero floor.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMP REFRESHED, NUMBER UNCHANGED. 'generate_service_types.py --count' reads 18 in a clean detached worktree of ed0d70a60d6. Re-stamped because the old stamp named a commit the 2026-09-02 sync replayed away.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python tooling/codegen/generate_service_types.py --count -- and it reads 18, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

Registrations under addons/web/static/src that register a service but do not `export const` its factory, so generate_service_types.py cannot type them. 18 of 46 (39%) the day the counter was added.

The generator has warned about each one to stderr since it was written, and service_types.yml tees that to a log; nothing read it and nothing held it. This is the shape the repository ratchets everywhere else, so it is a floor now: the number can fall and cannot rise.

Paying one down is a one-line change in the service's own file -- `const errorService = {` becomes `export const errorService = {` -- after which the service gains a type in @types/services.d.ts and the floor drops by one.

Not to be confused with the separate fact that service_types.yml is red at HEAD: the committed services.d.ts still imports names these files no longer export. Regenerating is the workflow's own remedy and would drop the 18 from the types rather than typing them, which is a decision for whoever owns web's services.
